title: Week 9 Study Home

stages.title: Bring your image into the sketch
stages.goal: Load an image you understand, then explain the difference between its stored dimensions and the canvas displaying it.

stages.title: Build a grid from sampled colors
stages.goal: Make a mosaic and explain how nested loops visit source locations and place corresponding blocks on the canvas.

stages.title: Find the four numbers for a pixel
stages.goal: Trace a source coordinate to its RGBA address and distinguish an array position from the color stored there.

stages.title: Choose what keeps its color
stages.goal: Use a spatial condition and transformation strength to test what a viewer notices first.

stages.title: Give the change a real minute
stages.goal: Connect elapsed time to the color transformation and inspect a deliberate beginning, middle and ending.

stages.title: Replay and fill the presentation screen
stages.goal: Present the same intended journey twice and keep its composition usable at the actual display size.

stages.title: Make, watch and document together
stages.goal: Turn your experiments into a silent paired project with real evidence, a rehearsed presentation and complete submission links.

saveRoutine: In the p5 Web Editor, Save the sketch and verify its actual saved sketch URL.
Open the saved code/fullscreen links and check the intended version.
In the workbook, Export progress to keep notes, checkpoints and your current small step.
Keep the matching sketch.js and source image together; preserve each tested iteration.
Update your actual observations and partner log, then begin the next session from the same study-home address.
